exposure: Suggestion for CS by delivery obstetrician
Suggestion for CS by prenatal care doctor
Women without medical indications for CS
outcome: Preference for CS in early and late pregnancy
Factors related to CS performed without medical indications
cohort: 272 first-time mothers attending their first postnatal check-up at a university affiliated obstetrics and gynecology hospital in Shanghai, China
finding: Healthcare provider suggestion for cesarean section was a strong predictor of cesarean section being performed, even among women who initially preferred vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Among primiparous women without a medical indication for CS, those who had a CS despite recalling a preference for vaginal delivery were more likely to have had a CS suggested by a prenatal care doctor (OR 20, 95% CI: 3.88-107.1) or by a delivery obstetrician (OR 26, 95% CI: 6.26-105.8).
